description: This file contains test cases for parsing functions 'parseNodeList' and 'parsePairingList', which handle node list payloads and pairing list payloads respectively, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: parseNodeList
methods.description: Parses a payload to extract a list of nodes, returning an array of node objects or empty array for invalid input.

methods.name: parsePairingList
methods.description: Parses pairing list payloads, returning an object with 'pending' and 'paired' arrays, handling malformed or invalid input gracefully.
